translations.web: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
translations.bsb: After David had finished speaking with Saul, the souls of Jonathan and David were knit together, and Jonathan loved him as himself.
